components.name: Clinical signs and symptoms of DVT
Alternative diagnosis is less likely than PE
Immobilisation >= 3 days or surgery in previous 4 weeks
Active cancer (treatment within 6 months or palliative)

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.action: Apply PERC only after confirming the patient is otherwise appropriate for the low-risk pathway.

interpretation.label: Moderate Risk
interpretation.action: Use the HJH pulmonary embolism algorithm, including age-adjusted D-dimer where applicable.

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.action: Follow the HJH high-risk pathway: assess contraindications, anticoagulation, and CTPA eligibility.
